title: Kivumishi Kirejeshi (amba-) (Theme 2: Michezo)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives amba- the ending of the noun's class and number (ambaye, ambao, ambacho, ambavyo, ambalo, ambayo) and does not repeat the relative in the verb.
representations: a class table of amba- endings

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "ambao" and joins two sentences with amba-.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kitabu ___ nilinunua ni kizuri." Kwa nini "ambaye" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Amba- huchukua mwisho unaolingana na ngeli ya nomino: kitabu ambacho, mwalimu ambaye.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Watoto ___ wanasoma ni werevu." Kwa nini "ambaye" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mtu mmoja: ambaye. Watu wengi: ambao.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mama ___ anauza mboga ni shangazi yangu." Kwa nini "amba" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Amba- haitumiki peke yake. Ina mwisho: ambaye, ambao, ambacho, ambayo.
Tumia amba- au -ye- katika kitenzi, si vyote viwili.
